hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^src/.*\.zig$'; then if zig build test >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Verify gate: zig build test PASSED.' >&2; else echo 'Verify gate: zig build test FAILED (advisory, not blocking) - run zig build test to see errors. Verify before done.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0
